violations.explanation: The `ScanPageButton` can be created as an icon-only button by setting the `label` parameter to `null`. If, in such a case, the `semanticsLabel` parameter is also not provided (i.e., it's `null`), the button will lack an accessible label. Screen readers will announce it merely as 'Button' without any descriptive text, making its purpose unclear to users with visual impairments. Although `semanticsLabel` is available to provide a description for icon-only buttons, its optional nature means it can be overlooked, leading to an accessibility barrier.
